title: Week of Nov 9, 2026
authoring: Edit this file once a week or the night before, then push. Three strength days: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 8:00 AM America/New_York. Each day needs its own id (2026-11-11-upper), date, dateLabel, time, title, notes, warmup, cooldown, and exercises. Each exercise needs sets, reps, weight, cues, and avoid (the common mistake). Shea is 50, rebuilding fitness, type 2 diabetes, dumbbells (one pair is 30 lb) and an adjustable bench, no barbell. Keep loads conservative. Never program a bench hip thrust or any move where he balances or could slide on the bench edge. Glutes are a floor glute bridge with one dumbbell on the hips, 3 x 12. A single-day object (exercises at the top, no days array) still loads.

schedule.offDays: Rest or treadmill day. No strength workout.

days.title: Full Body Day
days.subtitle: Monday · 8:00 AM · about 35 min · dumbbells + bench
notes: Keep a quick carb nearby (glucose tabs or juice). Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.
After lifting, a short rise in sugar is common. An easy 10-minute walk afterward helps.
First set of each move on the light end. Slow, clean reps beat heavy ones.
warmup: 5-minute easy walk on the Peloton Tread

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.weightNote: One dumbbell held at your chest
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest
Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit back and down, then drive up through your whole foot
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in. Push them out over your toes.
exercises.lastTime: Last time (Wed Nov 4): weight not logged. 20 lb is a safe start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Lie flat, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched back
Lower the dumbbells to chest level, elbows about 45° from your sides
Press up and slightly together, don't clank them
exercises.avoid: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.
exercises.lastTime: Last time (Mon Nov 2): 20 lb per hand, felt good. Same today.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: One knee and one hand on the bench, back flat like a table
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, not your chest
Lower slowly until your arm is straight
exercises.avoid: Twisting your torso to heave the weight up.
exercises.lastTime: Last time (Mon Nov 2): 30 lb, but form slipped and the last set was only 5 reps. So 25 lb today.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft bend in the knees, then keep them still
Push your hips back like closing a car door with your butt
Slide the dumbbells down your thighs to mid-shin, squeeze glutes to stand
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.
exercises.lastTime: Last time (Wed Nov 4): weight not logged. 20 lb per hand is a safe start.

exercises.name: Seated shoulder press
cues: Bench upright, back against the pad
Start with dumbbells at ear height, palms forward
Press straight up, then lower under control
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back off the pad.
exercises.lastTime: Last time (Mon Nov 2): 15 lb per hand. Same today.

exercises.name: Floor glute bridge
exercises.weightNote: One dumbbell on your hip bones
cues: Lie on your back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat
Rest the dumbbell on your hip bones, hold it with both hands
Drive your hips up, squeeze 1 second, lower slowly
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back at the top. Finish with your glutes.
exercises.lastTime: New move. It replaces the bench hip thrust, with nothing to slide off.

exercises.name: Dead bug (core finisher)
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent 90° over your hips
Press your lower back into the floor
Slowly reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, then switch
exercises.avoid: Letting your lower back pop off the floor.
exercises.lastTime: Last time (Wed Nov 4): bodyweight.

cooldown: Chest stretch in a doorway, 30 s
Hamstring stretch, heel on the bench, 30 s each

days.title: Upper Body
days.subtitle: Wednesday · 8:00 AM · about 45 min · dumbbells + bench
notes: Keep a quick carb nearby (glucose tabs or juice). Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.
After lifting, a short rise in sugar is common. An easy 10-minute walk afterward helps.
First set of each move on the light end. Slow, clean reps beat heavy ones.
Upper body today. If a shoulder pinches, skip that move and jot a note.
Two short posture moves today for forward-head posture. Keep them gentle.
warmup: 5-minute easy walk on the Peloton Tread
10 easy push-ups with hands on the bench, body in a straight line
10 shoulder-blade squeezes, arms at your sides

exercises.name: Chin tuck
exercises.weightNote: Hold 3 seconds each rep. Against a wall, or lie on your back
cues: Stand with the back of your head, shoulders, and hips against a wall, or lie on your back with knees bent
Eyes stay level. Make a gentle double chin and slide your head straight back
Hold 3 seconds, then ease back to the start. Breathe through the hold
exercises.avoid: Don't tip your chin down or poke your head forward to start the rep. This is a slide back, not a nod.
exercises.safety: Keep this gentle. Don't press on or load the neck. Stop if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
exercises.lastTime: New. Posture work for forward-head posture. Two easy sets is enough.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Lie flat, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched back
Lower the dumbbells to chest level, elbows about 45° from your sides
Press up and slightly together, don't clank them
exercises.avoid: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 9 full body: 20 lb per hand. Same weight today.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: One knee and one hand on the bench, back flat like a table
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, not your chest
Lower slowly until your arm is straight
exercises.avoid: Twisting your torso to heave the weight up.
exercises.lastTime: 30 lb slipped on Nov 2 (last set was 5 reps). Stay at 25 lb.

exercises.name: Seated shoulder press
cues: Bench upright, whole back against the pad, feet flat
Start with dumbbells at ear height, palms forward
Press straight up, then lower under control
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back off the pad.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 9: 15 lb per hand. Same today.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell fly
cues: Low incline, one notch. Head, back, and hips all on the pad, feet flat
Soft bend in the elbows. Open until you feel the chest
Hug the dumbbells back together over your chest
exercises.avoid: Don't perch on the edge, and don't let the weights sink behind your shoulders.
exercises.lastTime: New this week. 10 lb is light on purpose. If 10 isn't on the rack, use 15 for 8 reps.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows pinned near your ribs
Palms face each other the whole time, thumbs up
Curl to shoulder height, then lower for a full 3 seconds
exercises.avoid: Swinging your torso to start the weight.
exercises.lastTime: New this week. 15 lb per hand. Neutral grip is easier on the elbows.

exercises.name: Seated overhead triceps extension
cues: Bench upright, whole back against the pad
Both hands cup one end of the dumbbell over your head
Bend the elbows to lower it behind your head, then straighten
exercises.avoid: Flaring the elbows wide, or arching your lower back off the pad.
exercises.lastTime: New this week. 15 lb total is plenty. Skip it if the shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Chest-supported Y-T raise
exercises.weightNote: Empty hands, or 5 lb per hand if that is easy. 10 of Y, then 10 of T each set
cues: Low incline. Lie face down, chest on the pad, feet on the floor, neck long in a light chin tuck
Thumbs up. Raise your arms into a Y, lower, then out into a T. Slow and even
Squeeze the shoulder blades toward your back pockets. Don't shrug
exercises.avoid: Don't yank the arms up with your upper traps, and don't lift your chest or head off the pad.
exercises.safety: Very light or no weight. Keep the neck relaxed; don't crane to look up. Stop if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
exercises.lastTime: New. Empty hands first. Add 5 lb only if every rep is smooth.

cooldown: Chest stretch in a doorway, 30 s
Lat stretch: both hands on the bench, sit your hips back, 30 s

days.title: Lower Body
days.subtitle: Friday · 8:00 AM · about 45 min · dumbbells + bench
notes: Keep a quick carb nearby (glucose tabs or juice). Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.
After lifting, a short rise in sugar is common. An easy 10-minute walk afterward helps.
First set of each move on the light end. Slow, clean reps beat heavy ones.
Lower body today. Soften the knees on the deadlift. Stop a set if a rep gets sloppy.
Chin tucks and a light rear-delt fly at the end for posture. Keep them gentle.
warmup: 5-minute easy walk on the Peloton Tread
10 hip hinges, hands on your thighs

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.weightNote: One dumbbell held at your chest
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest
Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit back and down, then drive up through your whole foot
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in. Push them out over your toes.
exercises.lastTime: Fri Nov 6: 20 lb, all 3×10 done. Up to 25 today. Drop back to 20 if a rep gets sloppy.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft bend in the knees, then keep them still
Push your hips back like closing a car door with your butt
Slide the dumbbells down your thighs to mid-shin, squeeze glutes to stand
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.
exercises.lastTime: Fri Nov 6: 20 lb per hand, all 3×10 done. Up to 25 today. Don't chase depth; drop to 20 if your back rounds.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
cues: Dumbbells hang at your sides, palms facing each other
Step one foot straight back and lower the back knee toward the floor
Push through the front foot to stand. A hand on the bench is fine if you wobble
exercises.avoid: Don't put your back foot up on the bench. Both feet stay on the floor.
exercises.lastTime: New. 10 lb per hand. Balance comes before load.

exercises.name: Floor glute bridge
exercises.weightNote: One dumbbell on your hip bones
cues: Lie on your back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat
Rest the dumbbell across your hip bones and hold it
Drive your hips up, squeeze 1 second, lower slowly
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back at the top. This stays on the floor, never on the bench.
exercises.lastTime: Fri Nov 6: 20 lb, 3×12. Up to 25 today.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
cues: Dumbbells at your sides. Feet hip-width, whole foot on the floor
Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower for 2 seconds
Stay tall. A fingertip on the bench is fine if you sway
exercises.avoid: Don't do these on a step or the bench edge. Nothing to slip off.
exercises.lastTime: New. 20 lb per hand. The floor is the platform.

exercises.name: Dead bug (core finisher)
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent 90° over your hips
Press your lower back into the floor
Slowly reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, then switch
exercises.avoid: Letting your lower back pop off the floor.
exercises.lastTime: Fri Nov 6: bodyweight, 8 each side.

exercises.name: Chin tuck
exercises.weightNote: Hold 3 seconds each rep. Against a wall, or lie on your back
cues: Stand with the back of your head, shoulders, and hips against a wall, or lie on your back with knees bent
Eyes stay level. Make a gentle double chin and slide your head straight back
Hold 3 seconds, then ease back to the start. Breathe through the hold
exercises.avoid: Don't tip your chin down or poke your head forward to start the rep. This is a slide back, not a nod.
exercises.safety: Keep this gentle. Don't press on or load the neck. Stop if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
exercises.lastTime: Same as Wednesday. Two easy sets is enough.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear-delt fly
exercises.weightNote: Per hand. Light on purpose. Use 5 lb if 10 feels heavy
cues: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, back flat, arms hang under your shoulders
Slight bend in the elbows. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they line up with your shoulders
Lead with the elbows, squeeze the rear shoulders, then lower for 2 seconds
exercises.avoid: Don't swing your torso or turn this into a shrug. The torso stays still.
exercises.safety: Keep it light. Neck stays long, eyes on the floor. Stop if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
exercises.lastTime: New. 10 lb is a ceiling, not a goal. 5 lb is fine.

cooldown: Doorway pec stretch, 30 s each side
Hamstring stretch, heel on the bench, 30 s each
Figure-4 glute stretch on the floor, 30 s each
Standing quad stretch, one hand on the bench, 30 s each
